searchText: <@466006586477772831> thansk for reviewing, when do you merge this change in bombora? <@808969530608451584> my fable was eager to fix buildoor 😄 https://github.com/ethpandaops/buildoor/pull/192 oh wow it seems like it implemented it to be backward compatible for now, that's nice so should I remove trailing slashes everywhere or these PRs are to accept all variations? after 168 spec change, the trailing slash doesn't matter, but you need to update prysm I still don't understand, so updating prysm means that we will need to do the sanitizing and send just one string to the builder? I would have expected this to be handled at the builder level, not the client's what happens if the builder actually wants to get a trailing slash or :443 for whatever reason you can define custom auth data I agree builder could also handle it but then you need to interpret what derivation is acceptable and which isn't? like is trailing slash ok? maybe, what about other parts of the url, like userinfo? oh so this is in the case that the user only specifies the host? https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168 I think would prevent such issues a user has to provide the url though? it's only about what's signed over
